description: Client view (#196): a player teleports (execute in the_end) onto an obsidian platform above a freshly generated End's main island: the dragon fight starts, the dragon spawns, the ten crystals stand on the spikes and the client gets the dragon's boss bar. Back in the overworld (/tp at tick 70) the boss bar is removed at the fight's next player scan.

actions.command: execute in minecraft:the_end run tp steve 0.5 100.0 16.5
execute in minecraft:overworld run tp steve 8.5 -60.0 8.5
